title: Finite coefficient inclusions and fibres for the open Weil heart
statement: Fix the finite-field datum D, a prime l different from its characteristic, an algebraic closure Qbar of Q_l in an independent universe, and an open immersion j0:U0 -> X0 of separated finite-type schemes. The finite coefficient Weil inclusion, its natural Frobenius square, the underlying carrier functors, closed coefficient fibres and punctual upper bound are the literal constructions inherited from lem-zl-extension-by-zero-punctual; only their location changes.

source.place: proof (1) and (2), open extension by zero

proof.text: Move the existing constructions verbatim: the natural finite Frobenius square gives the fixed-pair inclusion, its included carrier satisfies both standard degree-zero classes, and restricting the literal H0 derived point fibre gives the closed coefficient fibre. No definition or arrow formula changes.
